name: microsoft-sql
description: Agent plugins for developing, operating, and migrating Microsoft SQL data platforms, including Azure SQL Database, local container workflows, Visual Studio Code, Fabric Database Hub, and SQL Server to Azure migration.

plugins.name: microsoft-azuresqldb-container
plugins.description: Develop and test applications locally with the Azure SQL Database container, including setup, secure connections, schema and data management, CI, migration from SQL Server containers, local-to-cloud workflows, APIs, and RAG.

plugins.name: microsoft-sql
plugins.description: Build and operate Azure SQL Database applications, from provisioning and secure connections through schema design, deployment, data movement, performance tuning, vector search, RAG, and local development with the Azure SQL Database container.

plugins.name: microsoft-sql-fdh
plugins.displayName: Microsoft SQL for Fabric Database Hub
plugins.description: Explore database inventory, performance, and security posture across Fabric Database Hub using read-only, Microsoft Entra-authenticated APIs for Azure SQL, Arc-enabled SQL Server, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and Fabric SQL.

plugins.name: microsoft-sql-migration
plugins.description: Plan and execute SQL Server migrations to Azure, including target selection, readiness assessment, prerequisite planning, SKU sizing, BACPAC, backup and restore, Log Replay Service, and post-migration validation.

plugins.name: microsoft-sql-vscode
plugins.displayName: Microsoft SQL for Visual Studio Code
plugins.description: Build and manage Azure SQL Database applications in Visual Studio Code with the MSSQL extension, including connections, schema and ORM workflows, deployment, diagnostics, security, data movement, recovery, T-SQL, vector search, and database projects. Data API Builder guidance is excluded where it would duplicate tools provided by the extension.
